messages:
elena: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks for the great questions about org changes. Posting a short thread to clarify a few points people asked about.

sam: Appreciate it. Can you confirm if there's a hiring pause for Q2 across engineering, or is it role-by-role?

elena: No company-wide freeze. We're tightening filters for some IC hires and prioritizing product-led infra and reliability roles this quarter. Role-by-role decisions will come from hiring managers + recruiting.

morgan: How should managers communicate approved headcount changes to their teams? Should we wait for HR to send templates?

elena: Managers can send a short note once they have written approval from recruiting + finance. HR will share a suggested template today via the HR channel. Keep messaging focused on why the change helps the team's roadmap.

raj: For Dedicated/Private workstreams — any changes to the platform teams? I heard a few teams might merge.

elena: We're merging parts of eng-runtime and eng-platform into a single "Serving" org to reduce duplication on deployment/runbook work. Most people will keep their current managers for now; we'll run a matching process for overlapping roles. No forced moves.

cassie: Will headcount targets shift for the backlog teams? Need to plan sprints.

elena: Headcount for backlog teams is mostly stable. A small number of roles are being reallocated to Serving and Observability. Recruiting will update the team hiring plans spreadsheet by EOD.

allhands-bot: Reminder: org-change FAQ doc uploaded to the handbook (link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/org-change-faq) :spiral_note_pad:

sam: On promotions/IC ladders — will the calibration windows change because of the reorg?

elena: Calibration cadence stays the same this cycle. We're just aligning ladders across the merged teams so leveling is consistent. If you have a specific case, DM People Ops and your director.

tal: Any expected overlap where two open reqs point to the same candidate pool? Want to avoid competing interviews.

elena: Good catch. Recruiting will gate reqs 1:1 for the next 30 days to avoid duplicate outreach. If a candidate looks like a fit for two teams, recruiting will coordinate and surface options to the candidate.

morgan: Can we get a quick list of the priority hire areas so product teams can decide whether to hold off on new project starts?

elena: Short list: Serving (runtime, batching, kernel infra), Observability (tracing/cost), and Platform Reliability. I'll paste a tiny table here:

```
Priority hires Q2
- Serving: 6 SWE, 2 infra eng
- Observability: 3 SWE
- Platform Reliability: 2 SWE
```

raj: Thanks — super helpful. Will recruiting publish req IDs so managers can reference them?

elena: Yes, recruiting will publish a public tracker with req IDs and statuses by tomorrow morning.

cassie: One operational ask: if teams are merging, how do we handle oncall rotations? Risk of gaps during the transition.

sam: We're drafting a short transition runbook with temporary overlap weeks. Eng-sre will own the schedule for the first two months of the merge.

elena: Final note: no involuntary role changes. If you're impacted by a manager change or role mapping, there will be 1:1s and an opt-in matching window. Thanks everyone for the thoughtful questions. I'll join the product standup at 3pm to address any leftover concerns. :wave:
